name: Exploring Image
description: Explores a screen the robot can only see - a Remote Desktop, Citrix or VNC session, a legacy app with no accessibility - through the robomotion-image-mcp server: reads it with OCR and computer vision into refs, performs the steps, and returns a recorded sequence of Robomotion.ImageAutomation nodes whose template images were verified unique on the screen. Use before writing any image automation flow.
